# Recorded by bbb-conform record. Review it with bbb-conform review before committing.
case join.presence.guest-approved
target fake

== step 1: call create
status 200
header Cache-Control no-cache
header Content-Type text/xml;charset=utf-8
body xml
/response/returncode "SUCCESS"
/response/meetingID "${uid}"
/response/internalMeetingID "<sha1(meetingID)>-<time>"
/response/attendeePW "<random>"
/response/moderatorPW "<random>"
/response/createTime "<time>"
/response/messageKey
/response/message

== step 2: presence join as mod
$.ejectReasonCode null
$.ejected null
$.extId "w_<id>"
$.guest false
$.guestStatus "ALLOW"
$.isModerator true
$.joinErrorCode null
$.joinErrorMessage null
$.joined true
$.loggedOut false
$.name "Mod"
$.role "MODERATOR"
$.sessionToken "<token>"
$.userId "w_<id>"

== step 3: presence join as eve
$.ejectReasonCode null
$.ejected null
$.extId "w_<id>"
$.guest true
$.guestStatus "WAIT"
$.isModerator false
$.joinErrorCode null
$.joinErrorMessage null
$.joined false
$.loggedOut false
$.name "Eve"
$.role "VIEWER"
$.sessionToken "<token>"
$.userId "w_<id>"

== step 4: graphql mutation Approve as mod
$.data.guestUsersSubmitApprovalStatus true

== step 5: presence join as eve
$.ejectReasonCode null
